title: `Core\Program`'s enumeration selects by a class as well as an interface, and `constructors<T, C>()` hands back one typed constructor per class
scope:
what `implementing<T>` and `implementingWith<T, S>` accept as `T`, and one new compiler-owned
member, `constructors<T, C>()`, answering the same list as closures. The scan, the order and the
per-request instances are unchanged and stay with their own records.
validatedBy: the conformance and reject cases the three rules' `guardedBy` names, and the scan opt-in test in `crates/nvs-hir/src/requires.rs`.
